task: M3 plan and apply for claude-code (v1-static-activation phase 4)

scenarios.scenario: Crafted journal step names (.., a/b, absolute, 300 bytes, .unam-tmp-x)
scenarios.rationale: Every name passes validate_dest_name before use; an invalid journal is rejected whole and nothing is created or deleted.

scenarios.scenario: Crafted journal op_id (../x), dest_rel (../..), project_root of another directory
scenarios.rationale: validate_begin checks the op id pattern, the adapter destination, and the canonical project root before any path is built.

scenarios.scenario: Hostile receipt_before in a journal (another target, an entry whose dest leaves the destination)
scenarios.rationale: receipt_before must parse as a receipt of this target and every skill entry must satisfy the P6 consistency rule, else journal-invalid.

scenarios.scenario: Crafted receipt entry with an escaping dest
scenarios.rationale: A receipt skill entry whose dest is not <destination>/<name> is carried untouched with receipt-entry-ignored; paths are always rebuilt from the destination root plus a validated name.

scenarios.scenario: Name escape through a skill frontmatter name
scenarios.rationale: An invalid name is a blocking conflict (exit 6) and nothing is written.

scenarios.scenario: Symlinked destination root (.claude or .claude/skills pointing outside)
scenarios.rationale: classify_dest_root resolves the root against the canonical project root; Outside and NotDir are conflicts at plan time and DestRootInvalid at apply, resume, and rollback time.

scenarios.scenario: Destination root swapped during the confirmation prompt
scenarios.rationale: ensure_dest_root runs after the prompt in change::run and again immediately before the first filesystem operation of execute.

scenarios.scenario: Removal of a modified owned entry (edited copy, retargeted link, real directory where a link was expected)
scenarios.rationale: remove_owned proves ownership by link text or tree hash twice; any mismatch is a skip that releases ownership and deletes nothing.

scenarios.scenario: Foreign collision (directory, file, symlink to the user directory, broken symlink, empty directory)
scenarios.rationale: An unreceipted present name is a blocking foreign-at-dest conflict; symlink_dir and copy_tree never overwrite an existing path.

scenarios.scenario: Symlink swapped between plan and apply (link replaced by a directory, or a path appearing before symlink or rename)
scenarios.rationale: Add observes Missing immediately before acting (dest-occupied otherwise); remove_owned re-checks after the first look and moves a changed copy back. Residual windows R1 and R3 are named.

scenarios.scenario: A source skill whose link leaves the skill (absolute, .. escape, chain)
scenarios.rationale: list_source refuses lexical and canonical escapes before anything is copied; the step fails with copy-refused and the others continue.

scenarios.scenario: A source changed between catalog load and copy
scenarios.rationale: The temp copy is re-hashed against the catalog hash; a mismatch is source-changed and the temp directory is removed.

scenarios.scenario: A second process (lock contention)
scenarios.rationale: Every mutating command takes a non-blocking OS lock first (exit 11); the contender never writes the lock file.

scenarios.scenario: A torn journal
scenarios.rationale: An unparsable last line is ignored; resume rewrites the valid text atomically before appending, so no record merges with torn bytes.

scenarios.scenario: Deletion outside the entry (recursive delete of a destination)
scenarios.rationale: The recursive removal appears once in production code, in remove_own_temp_dir, restricted to our own .unam-tmp- directory after lstat.

scenarios.scenario: A source path reaching a write function
scenarios.rationale: Writes are generic over the sealed Writable trait implemented only for DestPath, StatePath, ToolPath; the compile_fail doctest proves SourcePath is rejected.

scenarios.scenario: A symlinked or dangling .unam/lock, a symlinked .unam, a symlinked .unam/<target>, a symlinked journal
scenarios.rationale: lstat refusal before open, device and inode identity check after try_lock and before truncation (state-dir-invalid, exit 1).

scenarios.scenario: The project root equal to, inside, or containing a registered source
scenarios.rationale: ensure_project_outside_sources runs before the lock, so no .unam or .claude is ever created inside a source.

scenarios.scenario: A directory named .DS_Store with content inside an owned copy
scenarios.rationale: The manifest walk uses the same skip list as the hash; a .DS_Store is unlinked only when it is a regular file, anything else stays as residue.

scenarios.scenario: Interruption at any mutating call (crash or failure) followed by resume or rollback
scenarios.rationale: Write-ahead journal plus observation-based recovery; the every-N matrix over scenarios A, B, C with four modes and both recoveries reaches the clean-run or the start state.
